query: What exact primary and secondary outcomes, subgroup definitions, covariate sets, and multiple-testing corrections will be preregistered to ensure transparent policy-relevant inference?

response.query: What exact primary and secondary outcomes, subgroup definitions, covariate sets, and multiple-testing corrections will be preregistered to ensure transparent policy-relevant inference?
response.answer: Primary outcomes will measure PFAS concentrations; secondary outcomes will assess health effects. Subgroup definitions will include demographic and geographic factors. Covariate sets will include water source and treatment methods. Multiple-testing corrections will use the Bonferroni method.
